levels.title: Before the bus
levels.transitionText: Another morning of standing, waiting for the bus.
levels.instruction: Draw four loops, each around two insects of the same kind.
levels.designNote: Two Brimstones make the first available pair; no hazards or seed distraction. The clock waits for the first loop.

levels.title: The curbside patch
levels.transitionText: I like to watch the insects here, in this patch by the curbside.
levels.instruction: Draw five loops, each around two insects of the same kind.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. The two kinds are now equal in number, so a matching pair has to be picked out of a mixed field, and the clock runs from the start.

levels.title: Something in the air
levels.transitionText: Maybe I have an overactive imagination.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two loops with one insect and one seed.
levels.designNote: Add airborne seeds on a field with no hazard, so Seed & Wing is learned before anything can spoil it.

levels.title: In my thirties
levels.transitionText: In my thirties, I still don't feel like an adult sometimes.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two loops with one insect and one seed. Draw around the snail.
levels.designNote: Add a mid-field snail that spoils any loop holding it; the cast and the requirement repeat the visit before.

levels.title: Hard to save
levels.transitionText: It's hard to save, and prices keep getting higher.
levels.instruction: Make four combinations, including two loops with three different kinds of insect.
levels.designNote: Introduce the Roseate Hawkmoth for wide trio loops while the mid-field snail keeps crawling.

levels.title: Not how I imagined
levels.transitionText: This is not how I imagined adulthood.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including a matching pair, two loops with one insect and one seed, and a loop with three different kinds.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. Every Dawn figure on one field: three kinds, seeds, and the seam snail, so a trio has to be closed clear of the seeds.

levels.title: Lunch in the atrium
levels.transitionText: Today, for lunch, I bought myself a sandwich.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including two loops with three different kinds of insect. Draw over a flax flower to lengthen your next cord.
levels.designNote: Teach the bean on a clear field. Noon asks for more drawings than Dawn in the same time: the pressure is the count, not the shape.

levels.title: For now
levels.transitionText: I don't know how much longer my job will exist.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including three loops with one insect and one seed. A gust carries the seeds sideways; streaks cross the field two seconds before it.
levels.designNote: Introduce the two-second gusts alone. Nothing cuts the cord yet, so the only new judgement is when to close around a drifting seed.

levels.title: The glass and the leaves
levels.transitionText: This atrium makes me feel calmer.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including three loops with one insect and one seed. The hornet cuts a cord it touches.
levels.designNote: Introduce the wandering hornet on the field the gusts were learned on. The recipes stay simple and the count rises, so the visit asks for speed rather than care.

levels.title: At my age
levels.transitionText: At my age, my mother already held a high company position.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including one loop with a seed and three different insects. Pick a flax flower first: the loop is a long one.
levels.designNote: Introduce Seed & Trio, once, with the hornet and the gusts already familiar and no web. The bean is what makes the four-target loop reachable.

levels.title: Six years old
levels.transitionText: I was already six years old.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including two loops with one insect and one seed, and one loop with three different kinds. The web cuts a cord that touches it.
levels.designNote: Introduce the web under figures the player already draws quickly. It hangs where it will hang in the next visit.

levels.title: A future like that
levels.transitionText: It's hard for me to think of a future like that.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including two loops with a seed and three different insects. The web and the hornet cut a cord they touch.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. The longest loop of the day against the web, the hornet, and the breeze, and five more drawings around it.

levels.title: The way through
levels.transitionText: I always find myself walking home through here.
levels.instruction: Cross the cord to make two pockets. Make five combinations, including two figure-eights with a lacewing and a hoverfly in separate pockets.
levels.designNote: Teach the waist crossing. A resting lacewing and a holding hoverfly are the stillest pair in the game, so the new shape is learned against targets that wait.

levels.title: The gaps in the sound
levels.transitionText: I can hear the cicadas. And sometimes I can't.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including three figure-eights with two different kinds in separate pockets.
levels.designNote: Nothing new on the field. Brimstones join, so the figure-eight is drawn around a flier that does not wait. The cicada layer plays here.

levels.title: Carrying something home
levels.transitionText: Bringing home medicine today.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two Nurseries: one flier in one pocket and one seed in the other.
levels.designNote: Add seeds to the resting-insect field and introduce the Nursery, with no snail and no flax flower yet.

levels.title: Almost nominal
levels.transitionText: Some health coverages are almost nominal.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including a Nursery (1 flier and 1 seed) and a lacewing Counterpart Pair. The snail and the flax flower are back.
levels.designNote: The snail and the flax flower return to the Nursery field; defer mixed Echoes pending gesture calibration.

levels.title: The long way home
levels.transitionText: The long way home, where I pass by tall grasses and scrap metal
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two single loops and two figure-eights.
levels.designNote: First visit that asks for both shapes by name. Six fliers, so the switch is practised before the field fills.

levels.title: What places absorb
levels.transitionText: Some places absorb what developments expel.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including three single loops and two figure-eights.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. Require switching gestures amid eight fliers.

levels.title: Trying to sleep
levels.transitionText: I'm trying to sleep.
levels.instruction: Thread firefly, lacewing, then another firefly. Release to complete the trace.
levels.designNote: Introduce fireflies and Trace as threading in sequence under one-gesture string rules.

levels.title: Rows of car lights
levels.transitionText: I dream about endless rows of car lights.
levels.instruction: Make four traces: firefly, lacewing, then another firefly. A hoverfly threaded on the way spoils the trace.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. Hoverflies stand in the way of the same trace, so the line has to be routed and not only ordered.

levels.title: Day shift, night shift
levels.transitionText: I don't know if I like the day shift or night shift more.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations: include a pair, Seed & Wing, a figure-eight, and two traces.
levels.designNote: Add seeds to the familiar cast; combine looping and threading without mode switching. Xyh played it through without help.

levels.title: The window corner
levels.transitionText: I wake up often, and there's always rustling in the corner.
levels.instruction: A second trace: thread lacewing, firefly, then the other lacewing. Make five combinations, including three of these.
levels.designNote: Introduce the second Trace recipe, the first one turned round: two resting ends and a moving middle, so the player waits for a firefly to pass between the leaves. Only this recipe scores as a trace here.

levels.title: Figures
levels.transitionText: Just tracing figures, while the world moves around me.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including two single loops, a figure-eight, and two traces, one of them lacewing first. The jasmine settles one insect at a time.
levels.designNote: Introduce the night jasmine on the cast of the two visits before. Both Trace recipes score from here on.

levels.title: Tomorrow keeps happening
levels.transitionText: And the world does move. Because tomorrow keeps happening.
levels.instruction: Make seven combinations, including two single loops, two figure-eights, two traces of either kind, and a Nursery.
levels.designNote: Nothing new. Brimstones, one perimeter snail, and the flax flower return; every gesture of the day on the fullest field, with the jasmine to thin it.
